evidence_quotes.section1_quid_pro_quo: MISSING — call opens directly with moving blanket deposit discussion, no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote
evidence_quotes.section1_discovery: Name (Roger) known from prior contact; moving logistics unclear — no explicit ask for day, route, or size in this call
evidence_quotes.section2_their_agenda: NOT ASKED — rep never asked 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' — jumped straight into pricing
evidence_quotes.section3_logistics: MINIMAL — customer volunteers that a pod 'doesn't look like we're gonna need one' but rep does not probe property type, floors, rooms, walking distance, special items, or additional stops
evidence_quotes.section4_estimate_anchor: PARTIAL — rep gives range ($2,016–$2,304 for 7–8 hours, 3 movers) but does not personalize to customer's specific concerns or move prep; earlier mention of moving blanket deposit and pod confusion introduced friction
evidence_quotes.section4_feels_fair: NOT ASKED — no 'does that feel fair?' pause; rep moves straight from estimate into email confirmation
evidence_quotes.section6_final_concerns: THROWAWAY — 'do you have any other questions or anything for me' is the empty version, not a genuine 'what's still concerning you?'
evidence_quotes.section7_explicit_ask: FULL — 'would you like our help with your move?' (customer declined initially, but re-engaged with logistical questions)
evidence_quotes.section7_booking_confirmed: PARTIAL — email confirmed (R Kirsten @langleybani.com), but no date locked in; customer deferred to coordinate with floor people and call back; no crew size or arrival window finalized; no notes left for crew

top_strength: Nicole persisted through customer objections and clarified three-mover crew allocation and minimum charges when Roger raised concerns, demonstrating product knowledge and willingness to address hesitation.
coaching_note: Start every call with the quid pro quo framing (10–15 minutes, dependable quote, wait for yes) and ask their agenda before any pricing — this call jumped to moving blanket deposits and estimate details with no discovery of concerns, leaving the customer uncertain and unprepared to commit.
